speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your brother is at the street door, Master Shakespeare, and he will not come up until you say the stair is his.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The stair is his as far as the settle. Gilbert. You are late, or the letter is.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The letter is four days late. It was meant for St George's Day. I fetched it Thursday at the Bell, and it has lived in the other doublet since. I have not broken it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three days in a doublet is a long way to carry another man's news. Give it here. Sit, if you mean to read over my shoulder. You will anyway.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The settle is yours until the pot is skimmed. I count a brother at the door. I do not count his letter.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Then you shall not have it, Mistress. The first line is Anne's, and it is the frame.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The frame we saw in Chapel Street.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Is roofed. She sets that first.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Roofed is a different word from the frame we saw. I will take her word, and I will not add a price to it.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: She says the money came safe. There is no sum in the line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then there is no sum in this room. A safe penny and a safe pound use the same word. She picked the word.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The bailiff's man has not been at the porch these two Sundays, and your father says it is the weather.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Is the porch your doing?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's the weather.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: That is his sentence, said back to him from a hundred miles off.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is the sentence he sent. I am not improving him, and I am not improving her. I do not have a better one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the porch is settled at my door as well. I will hear the roof and the weather when you come to the board. The rest of a wife's letter is not a pot.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: There is a line from each of the children. Three hands, or one hand three ways.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Which is the straight one.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Susanna's. It is correct. I am not going to mend a girl who is already right.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave her correct. She is eleven, and she is right. That is ordinary luck, and I will not spend it. The boy.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Hamnet reports a race won. He does not say against whom. A boy writes the victory and leaves the field out.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then he won it. I am not asking the field.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Judith has drawn a man on a stage with his arms out. Your elder girl has written under it. Father talking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She has the arms. The name she left to her sister, who would not let a drawing go without a word.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: You will answer them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: When a sheet goes back. I am not answering a brother on the stair and calling it a letter.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I am not staying for the second reading. You will read it better without a man breathing on the seal.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go, then. I will not make you my messenger twice.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I am not your messenger once. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. The frame is heard. That is all I am saying today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The board is at six, if a letter has left you able to eat. Threepence, the same as a Sunday with no brother in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat. The second reading is mine, and it is not for the table.
